title: record --sign
caption: record appends a verdict, signed with the reviewer's own software key. These are DEMO verdicts on a synthetic registration.
alt: Terminal output of pr-rla record 1 pass with --sign

commands.command: pr-rla record 1 pass --reviewer demo-reviewer --note "DEMO verdict, not a review" --sign ../keys/demo-ed25519
commands.output:
